name: Minnesota Intrastate Pipeline Company
monitor_reason: length: no sourced length and no concrete project. The only evidence is an operator contact list naming the company as a gas transmission operator. No new pipe, route, status or endpoints found. Fails the 25 km length rule and the concrete-step leg.
researcher_notes: The Minnesota Department of Public Safety pipeline operator contact list names Minnesota Intrastate Pipeline Company as a gas transmission operator. It appears in the PHMSA operator ID list as well. No existing GEM row carries this name. A web search found no length, route or project for it. A state summary lists one intrastate system of 89 miles, Hutchinson Pipeline, which is a different operator. Nothing here shows at least 25 km of new pipe. An operator listing alone does not show a new pipeline. Left as a monitor item.
